The answer recorded for this beat: the white ground and the vermillion the densest cell's ring and
its label are drawn in.

`origin: journalist`. Not the house pair, and no subject convention produces it — `matchConvention`
reads "earthquake density" and returns nothing, because the four grounded conventions are
renewables, fossil, water and heat and none fires on seismicity.

**It now carries the whole hex field.** The cell shading is the one thing a reader reads a count
off, and until 2026-08-10 it was derived between the ground and the ink — grey, whatever anybody
recorded, with one vermillion ring on top. `render-web.mjs` passes the accent to `dataRampEnd`, so
every class carries it and the map moves when the recorded answer moves.

Measured against this ground: 5.15:1, clear of the 3:1 mark floor.
